name: TradingView
description: TradingView lets agents read market data and analytics for symbols, such as prices and technical indicators, with the signed-in TradingView account. It does not place trades.

prompts.text: Give me an overview of AAPL's price action over the last month.
What do the RSI and moving averages show for BTCUSD on the daily chart?
Compare the year-to-date performance of the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq 100.

apps.name: TradingView
apps.description: Market data and technical analysis, over TradingView's MCP server with browser sign-in.
